title: Troves/STRKFarm retired vaults (Starknet) — $24.9k unclaimed user recovery balances; no unprivileged extraction
closed_reasons: withdraw_zklend pays only the caller's own recorded position, exactly once ('Zklend::Already claimed' replay guard); non-holders get no transfer
claim_zklend/set_batch_amount/transfer/register_zklend/swap/unwind_dapp2/unpause/set_settings/upgrade are owner-only ('Caller is not the owner')
Sensei withdraw/rebalance/harvest are pause-gated ('Pausable: paused'); all four Sensei vaults is_paused()=1
AutoCompounding harvest is permissionless but dead: Ekubo distributor has no claim for the vaults (revert 'Removed')
receiver parameter does not pay the receiver's position when the caller has none (caller-based claims proven by simulation)
key_facts: DefiLlama strkfarm adapter hard-codes retiredBalance=0 for AutoCompounding (2) and Sensei (4) vaults; Troves = renamed STRKFarm (protocol id 4952)
Six retired vaults hold live funds at blocks 16,154,131-16,154,146: 15,720.450411 USDC + 2.668048629 ETH + 34,878.685553 STRK = $24,966.19 (DefiLlama 2026-10-10)
Vaults upgraded to the recovery class at blocks 1,242,433/1,243,009 and 1,273,089-1,273,097 (~2025-03-28, zkLend recovery claim launch)

Claim simulation: withdraw_zklend(1, own) transfers exactly zklend_position(own,1) — e.g. 826,786,388,187,987 STRK and 2,368 USDC for address 0x3495dd1e...; second call reverts 'Zklend::Already claimed'
Non-holder withdraw_zklend from unprivileged senders: SUCCESS with zero token transfers on AC and Sensei vaults
Receiver-basis test (random caller, receiver=position-holder): SUCCESS with zero transfers -> claims are caller-based, no third-party payout
Owners are single-owner Braavos accounts (class 0x36078334...527f), no timelock; upgrade could sweep the same H-O funds (P risk)
zkLend zTokens held (331,565.68 zSTRK + 1,115,739.03 zUSDC + 615.31 zETH) have no redemption path today; future recovery distributions would flow through the owner-register + user-withdraw pipeline
caveats: Vault Cairo source is not public; gates proven behaviourally via starknet_call/starknet_simulateTransactions traces and decoded revert strings, not source review
H-O amount is point-in-time (block 16,154,146) and excludes the unquantified open Nostra legs (get_nostra_amount: 9,522.31 / 15,444.99 / 1.1253 / 0.3532 receipt units) and the zkLend zTokens

AutoCompounding harvest is permissionless and takes a caller-supplied Avnu swap route; dead today ('Removed') but would re-arm if a new Ekubo claim is allocated; old-class beneficiary guard could not be exercised
Owner (P) upgrade power applies to the same $24.97k and is not double-counted in the categories
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0.00 live from the Troves/STRKFarm retired vaults; the ~$24.9k is unclaimed user zkLend-recovery balances (H-O) withdrawable only by each recorded claimant once, with all admin/swap/harvest paths owner-gated, paused, or dead.
